



Network Working Group                                          T. Rogers
Internet-Draft                                             Synaptics Lab
Intended status: Informational                         28 September 2026
Expires: 1 April 2027


          The X402 Typed Settlement Wire Protocol (X402-TSWP)
                    draft-shabazz-http-x402-tswp-01

Abstract

   This document specifies the X402 Typed Settlement Wire Protocol
   (X402-TSWP), an application-layer framing extension to HTTP status
   code 402 (Payment Required).  It defines machine-to-machine
   challenge-response headers, a typed discriminator registry, and byte-
   exact multi-rail blockchain settlement grammars.  The protocol is
   deployed in production with sub-400 ms cross-border finality.

1.  Introduction

   [RFC9110] reserves HTTP 402 for future use.  X402-TSWP provides a
   deterministic, multi-rail settlement protocol with atomic PTB
   pipelines.

   The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "REQUIRED", "SHALL", "SHALL NOT",
   "SHOULD", "SHOULD NOT", "RECOMMENDED", "NOT RECOMMENDED", "MAY", and
   "OPTIONAL" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP
   14 [RFC2119] [RFC8174] when, and only when, they appear in all
   capitals, as shown here.

2.  The X402-TSWP Wire Grammar

   All payloads are 7-bit ASCII.  Grammar (ABNF [RFC5234]):

   x402-payload   = "X402" type-tag [ ":" sub-type ] ":" payload
   type-tag       = ALPHA ; Uppercase A-Z
   sub-type       = ALPHA ; Optional qualifier
   payload        = 1*128( VCHAR ) ; Printable ASCII

3.  Operational Discriminator Registry

   X402G:<challenge>  Gateway challenge (UUIDv4 [RFC4122]).

   X402L:<lane>:<window>:<nonce>  Concurrent lane execution (ADR-062).

   X402W:<window>:<participant>  Net-settlement wire.

   X402M:<corridor>:<maker>  Margin escrow.



Rogers                    Expires 1 April 2027                  [Page 2]

Internet-Draft                  X402-TSWP                 September 2026


   X402MR:<corridor>:<maker>  Margin return.

   X402N:<session>:<net>  Net readback.

   X402E:<corridor>:<uetr>  ISO 20022 UETR linkage.

   X402B:<session>  Session bonding.

   X402BN:<session>  Bond initiation.

   X402BR:<session>  Bond release.

   X402A:<asset>:<mint>:<decimals>  Asset binding — issuer-agnostic
      instrument identification; binds the settlement asset symbol to its
      on-chain token mint identifier (base58, exactly 32 bytes) and wire
      decimals (0..255, enforced by SPL Token-2022 "transfer_checked").
      Inaugural registration: OUSD (Open Standard; Token-2022 mainnet mint
      ousd2mJsPEckLHcSCDxyKD7NDGARZcfLbDZkKiatYHB, decimals 6).

4.  HTTP Header Specifications

4.1.  Server Challenge (402 Payment Required)

   HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
   WWW-Authenticate: X402-TSWP challenge="827da995-adda-4dd7-
     9fb5-d05338526873", rails="solana,xrpl", amount="160",
     unit="drops", recipient="rKmt...",
     memo-grammar="X402G:<challenge>",
     expires="1789860818"

4.2.  Client Authorization Header

   GET /mcp/v1/tools/call HTTP/1.1
   Host: api.synapticchain.xyz
   Authorization: X402-TSWP rail="solana-devnet",
     tx="4uQ7T...", type="L",
     memo="X402L:151:1789860218:806384975"

4.3.  Payment Receipt Header

   HTTP/1.1 200 OK
   X402-Receipt: rail="solana-devnet",
     leaf="a161f585...", status="settled"

5.  Security Considerations

   Replay attacks are prevented by one-time UUID challenges and the
   256-bit sliding window per lane (ADR-062).  Byte-exact verification
   and constant-time comparison mitigate side-channel and injection
   attacks.

6.  IANA Considerations






Rogers                    Expires 1 April 2027                  [Page 3]

Internet-Draft                  X402-TSWP                 September 2026


6.1.  HTTP Authentication Scheme Registration

   Register "X402-TSWP" in the HTTP Authentication Scheme Registry.

6.2.  Header Field Registration

   Register "X402-Receipt" as a permanent dictionary field.

6.3.  ALPN Protocol ID Registration

   Register protocol "x402" with ID 0x78 0x34 0x30 0x32 per [RFC7301].
